verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the official GitHub README, which lists idempotency among the product's core reliability features. There is no documentation of how idempotency keys are set, scoped or expire, and nothing on exactly-once step semantics or deduplication of duplicate triggers. Missing for 10: documented idempotency-key API (scope, TTL, behavior on duplicate trigger), exactly-once step/subtask semantics, guarantees against duplicate side effects across retries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a backend developer, idempotency keys and exactly-once step semantics stop duplicate triggers from double-charging or double-sending

citations.quote: Build rock solid agents and AI applications using our durable tasks, retries, queues and idempotency.
